description: Write an unambiguous representation, octal bytes by default, of FILE to standard output.

option.name: --address-radix
tip: output format for file offsets; RADIX is one of [doxn], for Decimal, Octal, Hex or None

option.name: --endian
tip: swap input bytes according the specified order

option.name: --format
tip: select output format or formats

option.name: --output-duplicates
tip: do not use * to mark line suppression

option.name: --read-bytes
tip: limit dump to BYTES input bytes

option.name: --skip-bytes
tip: skip BYTES input bytes first

option.name: --strings
tip: show only NUL terminated strings of at least BYTES (3) printable characters

option.name: --traditional
tip: accept arguments in third form above

option.name: --width
tip: output BYTES bytes per output line; 32 is implied when BYTES is not specified

option.name: -a
tip: same as -t a, select named character, ignoring high-order bit

option.name: -b
tip: same as -t o1, select octal 1 bytes per unit

option.name: -B
tip: same as -t o2, select octal 2 bytes per unit

option.name: -c
tip: same as -t c, select printable character or backslash escape

option.name: -d
tip: same as -t u2, select unsigned decimal 2 bytes per unit

option.name: -D
tip: same as -t u4, select unsigned decimal 4 bytes per unit

option.name: -e
tip: same as -t f8, select floating point 8 bytes per unit

option.name: -f
tip: same as -t fF, select floating point

option.name: -F
tip: same as -t f8, select floating point 8 bytes per unit

option.name: -H
tip: same as -t x4, select hexadecimal 4 bytes per unit

option.name: -i
tip: same as -t dI, select signed decimal

option.name: -I
tip: same as -t d8, select signed decimal 8 bytes per unit

option.name: -l
tip: same as -t dL, select signed decimal

option.name: -L
tip: same as -t d8, select signed decimal 8 bytes per unit

option.name: -o
tip: same as -t o2, select octal 2 bytes per unit

option.name: -O
tip: same as -t o4, select octal 4 bytes per unit

option.name: -s
tip: same as -t d2, select signed decimal 2 bytes per unit

option.name: -x
tip: same as -t x2, select hexadecimal 2 bytes per unit

option.name: -X
tip: same as -t x4, select hexadecimal 4 bytes per unit

global_option.name: --help
tip: display this help and exit

global_option.name: --version
tip: output version information and exit
